title: Master 1-1 segment tab panels
description: Five on-page buyer-profile panels for a canonical brand-a-vs-brand-b hub. Do not append the segment label to generic vendor copy. Each panel is a verdict plus unique decision factors only.

verdict.description: 1–2 standalone Pick A / Pick B sentences for this buyer profile only. Do not append a fixed runner-up suffix, a bolted-on “for [Segment]” clause, or jargon such as benches, corridors, headcount traps, or liquidity.

items.description: Insight unique to this segment. No repeated baseline features (owned-entity counts, generic tax filings) and no mechanical segment-name concatenation.
